name: Real Tree Woodworking
old_description: We have been in business since 2012 with over 50 years of combined experience on staff. Our production space is located in Duxbury, Vermont, 5 minutes outside of Waterbury, just off of Route 100. Although we are based in central Vermont, we have worked successfully with customers all over Vermont as well as up and down the East Coast, including New Hampshire, Massachusetts, and New York.
about:
Real Tree Woodworking operates from a 3,500-square-foot shop in Duxbury, Vermont, just off Route 100 near Waterbury. The business traces its roots to 2004 when Jon Deerfield founded Nature's Curve Woodworking in an artist community in Niagara Falls, New York, after earning a BFA in Furniture Design and apprenticing with two master craftsmen—including work on a Frank Lloyd Wright house restoration. Deerfield relocated to Vermont in 2007 to join Wall/Goldfinger, a high-end commercial furniture maker serving clients such as the New York Stock Exchange, the White House, and the Federal Reserve. In spring 2012 he relaunched the venture as Real Tree Woodworking, which has grown steadily since.

The shop produces custom cabinetry, furniture, doors, and architectural trim on a build-to-order basis, and also offers piecework processing of solid wood, sheet goods, real wood veneer, and laminate for other builders and DIYers. A dedicated finishing room rounds out the in-house capabilities. The current team comprises Deerfield and three woodworkers—Matt Joyce (since 2022), John Crowne (since 2021), and D.J. Rummell (since 2025)—working in the 3,500 sq ft facility.

Customers span residential and commercial construction across Vermont and the East Coast (New Hampshire, Massachusetts, New York). The client base includes architects, designers, general contractors, and other woodworking shops. Notable past projects include commercial office furniture for Wall/Goldfinger's institutional accounts and the Frank Lloyd Wright restoration.

Deerfield emphasizes a "build it well and build it to last" philosophy rooted in his apprenticeship background and the disciplined production standards honed at Wall/Goldfinger, positioning the shop as a reliable partner for both one-off custom pieces and repeat production runs.

name: Red V Foods
old_description: Red V Foods’ dedicated teams of experts are ready to assist you with your company’s needs. We are a full-service distributor and manufacturer of coconut products and a leading contract packaging partner for private label retailers. Our SQF-certified facility and skilled production crew adhere to the strictest compliance standards. With over 100,000 sq. ft. of climate-controlled warehousing and reliable third-party logistics partners, we work to ensure your company stays on target.
about:
Red V Foods operates from Buford, Georgia, where its history traces back to the mid-1800s. The company's founders developed a desiccation process to prevent spoilage of coconut goods during long voyages from Asia. Today, Red V Foods is a subsidiary of Axelum Resources Corp., a Philippines-based manufacturer of coconut ingredients.

The company manufactures and distributes a range of coconut products including desiccated, sweetened, and toasted coconut, coconut milk powder, cream, milk, and oil. It runs an 11,000-square-foot manufacturing and distribution facility alongside more than 100,000 square feet of climate-controlled warehousing. A team of over 40 employees handles sourcing, manufacturing, co-packing, private labeling, and oil-filling services, supported by Axelum's 4,000-plus workforce in the Philippines.

Red V Foods serves food and beverage brands, food manufacturers, food service providers, distributors, and retailers across North and South America, including the U.S., Canada, Mexico, Brazil, and Chile. It acts as a co-packing partner for several large retail brands, offering custom formulation and packaging.

The company emphasizes a direct supply chain through its parent company, eliminating middlemen, and maintains SQF certification with GMP and HACCP programs. Its facility is also certified organic, non-GMO, kosher, and halal. Axelum's laboratories hold ISO 17025 accreditation, and the parent company pursues near-zero-waste manufacturing and community development programs.

name: Regal Plastics
old_description: Bring us your CNC machining, welding, or custom fabrication plastic project, and our onsite fabrication specialists will take the time to come up with a personalized plastic solution. You'll work with an account manager that will be available by call, text, or email anytime you need a status update on your custom plastic part fabrication project.
about:
Regal Plastics was founded in 1976 in Irving, Texas. The company is led by CEO Chad, who emphasizes core values of continuous improvement, transparency, and authenticity.

The company operates as both a wholesale plastic supplier and a custom fabrication shop. It stocks a range of sheet materials including Plexiglass (acrylic), polyethylene, polycarbonate, UHMW, SkyPoly multiwall polycarbonate, and HDPE. Fabrication services encompass saw cutting, CNC routing, plastic welding, edgework, and bending, supported by multiple CNC machines for high-capacity machining. Regal Plastics ships nationwide across the continental United States, Mexico, and Canada, and reports having recycled 82,146 pounds of plastic.

Its customer base spans printing and signage, packaging, building and construction, food and beverage, and exhibit, event, and tradeshow industries. Clients work with an account manager accessible by call, text, or email for project updates.

Regal Plastics differentiates itself through a culture of self‑improvement—captured in values like “All In and Play to Win,” “Courageously Candid,” and “Learn, Improve, Grow”—and by promising quote turnaround in hours rather than days.

name: Remington Medical
old_description: Founded by Fred L. Aycock in 1992, Remington Medical Inc. specializes in medical devices. The maintenance, time, and money put into cleaning and sterilizing medical devices led us to develop some of the first disposable cables, some still in use today. Our business designs, manufactures, and distributes all our devices from our three facilities to save money and pass the savings onto our customers.
about:
Remington Medical was founded in 1992 by Fred L. Aycock in Alpharetta, Georgia. The company began by developing disposable cables to address the maintenance, time, and cost burdens of cleaning and sterilizing reusable medical devices, with some of those early cable designs still in use today.

The company designs, manufactures, and distributes its medical devices from three facilities, bringing functions such as injection molding, tooling, and prototyping in-house to maintain control over the entire production process. Remington also operates as a contract manufacturer, providing customized solutions for clients that lack the capacity or desire to develop products internally.

Remington serves original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) across the medical device sector, with particular experience in Class II devices. Its contract manufacturing customers come from a variety of clinical specialties, and the company supports projects ranging from prototype development through full-scale production.

Remington emphasizes that keeping all manufacturing functions under one roof yields a superior product and allows cost savings to be passed to customers. The firm’s ISO 13485 certification underscores its commitment to quality management for medical devices.

name: Renewable Energy Design Group
old_description: Since 2012, our team has helped residential and commercial customers in the Carolinas take advantage of the sun’s energy and the abundant financial benefits that go with it. Don’t wait to fight against the rising costs of conventional electricity.
about:
Renewable Energy Design Group operates from Charlotte, North Carolina, and has served the Carolinas since its founding in 2012. The company focuses on solar energy consulting and installation for both residential and commercial clients across North and South Carolina. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The firm provides end-to-end solar solutions including system design, photovoltaic installation, and battery storage integration. Its services cover residential rooftop arrays, commercial-scale projects, and backup power systems that function during grid outages. The team produces custom energy analyses that estimate return on investment for each property, though facility size, headcount, and annual project volumes are not published.

Customers include homeowners seeking to hedge against rising utility rates and businesses aiming to lower operating costs. The company works with Duke Energy's PowerPair rebate program and has completed installations in regions such as the Triad. Affiliations include EnergySage, Sustain Charlotte, Solarize Triad, and the Piedmont Environmental Alliance.

The business was established to help Carolinians capture the financial and resilience benefits of solar energy. It emphasizes NABCEP-certified expertise and holds an A+ rating from the Better Business Bureau as markers of workmanship quality.

name: Renewable Energy Systems, LLC
old_description: Being in business since 2008, we have been the pioneers in our industry for Indiana and surrounding areas. With that in mind, we have faced all challenges, old and new. We have also gained the experience to guide our customers in making the best decisions for their energy investment.
about:
Renewable Energy Systems, LLC was founded in 2008 in Avilla, Indiana. The independently owned and operated company began as a pioneer in solar energy for Indiana and surrounding areas, focusing on giving customers control over their electricity production and usage.

The firm provides end-to-end solar photovoltaic services, including engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) for commercial, industrial, agricultural, and residential projects. Its capabilities cover custom system design, installation, and operations & maintenance (O&M) repair, with experience delivering utility-scale systems exceeding 1 megawatt. All installations are performed by NABCEP-certified technicians, and the company operates a Department of Labor-registered apprenticeship program to train solar professionals.

Renewable Energy Systems serves businesses, farms, schools, and homeowners across northeastern Indiana, southern Michigan, and northwestern Ohio. Commercial clients receive systems designed to reduce energy costs, while industrial customers can access utility-scale engineering and subcontracting services. Agricultural projects target operational efficiency, and residential installations aim to maximize home energy production.

The company distinguishes itself through a veteran-friendly hiring program recognized with the HIRE Vets Medallion Award, a commitment to NABCEP certification across its workforce, and a service model that assigns the same technician from initial assessment through installation and future maintenance. It also assists customers with federal tax credits, USDA REAP grants, and depreciation strategies to improve project economics.

name: Renogy
old_description: Renogy is a solar energy product manufacturer based in California. Produces monocrystalline and flexible solar panels, along with charge controllers, battery systems and other solar components for RV, marine and off-grid applications.
about:
Renogy, a solar energy product manufacturer, was founded in 2009 and is headquartered in Chino, California. The company employs between 200 and 499 people.

The company produces monocrystalline and flexible solar panels, charge controllers, battery systems, inverters, battery monitors, and DC-DC chargers. Its product line includes the ShadowFlux™ N-Type anti-shading solar panels with 25% efficiency, 12V 300Ah LiFePO4 batteries with low-temperature protection, and pure sine wave inverters delivering over 90% efficiency. Manufacturing scale is reflected in a workforce of up to 499 employees, though facility size and annual volumes are not disclosed.

Renogy serves recreational vehicle (RV), marine, commercial, and off-grid markets, as well as tiny-house and workshop DIY customers. Its solutions are marketed for RV expeditions, tiny-house energy independence, and workshop productivity.

The company emphasizes anti-shading technology, dual alternator-and-solar charging, and high-accuracy battery monitoring as key differentiators for off-grid reliability.

name: Request Foods
old_description: Since 1990, Request Foods has been making mouth-watering main dishes, appetizers, desserts, and more for the world’s leading brands, retailers, and restaurants. Along the way, we’ve been actively engaged within the food industry, our community, and supplier network to provide fresh ideas and solutions that provide opportunities for mutual success.
about:
Request Foods was founded in 1990 in Holland, Michigan, as a co-packing and contract manufacturing partner for food brands. The company operates from a 903,000-square-foot facility that houses cooking, blending, freezing, and packing lines.

The company produces nearly 800 custom entrées, side dishes, appetizers, sauces, and desserts, each formulated to specific customer requirements. Its culinary team develops recipes from concept through commercialization, handling processes such as sauce simmering, fresh pasta extrusion from durum semolina, cooking, blending, freezing, and packaging. The facility supports scaled production for startups, private-label programs, and national brands.

Request Foods serves startups and small brands looking to replicate and scale authentic recipes, private-label brands seeking to diversify offerings, and national brands requiring consistent high-volume production. Its customers include retailers, club stores, foodservice operators, and restaurants.

The company emphasizes culinary creativity and dependable consistency, investing in technology to improve capacity, speed, scalability, ingredient freshness, and quality assurance. Beyond production, it offers branding, marketing, distribution, and logistics support, aiming to exceed customer expectations through a mission of continuous excellence.

name: Resco Products Inc
old_description: No application is too challenging for our team of experts. As a leading global manufacturer of refractory our high-quality products and service coupled with our attention to detail we’re driven to surpass your application expectations.
about:
Resco Products Inc. was founded in 1976 in Moulton, Alabama, as a privately owned refractory manufacturer. The company began as a supplier of high-temperature materials for heavy industry and has since expanded into a global provider of refractory solutions.

Resco manufactures a full line of refractory products including brick, clay-alumina castables, gun mixes, magnesia-based specialties, mortars, plastics, and precast shapes. Its capabilities encompass custom refractory design, engineering support, and extensive testing of mechanical, physical, and high-temperature properties. The company operates an experienced engineering department backed by state-of-the-art equipment to develop tailored solutions for demanding applications.

Resco serves major industries such as steel, copper, nickel, aluminum, hydrocarbon processing, cement, and lime production. Concrete applications include steel ladles, cement kilns, copper and nickel smelting, CO boilers, and ferro alloy furnaces. The company also supports nonferrous metals and petrochemical sectors with specialized refractory linings.

Resco emphasizes its people as its core strength, citing their knowledge base, experience, and dedication to customer service as the foundation of its mission. The company highlights unparalleled refractory applications expertise, value-added solutions, individually inspected products, and a commitment to innovation that aims to decrease downtime and increase yield volumes for customers. In January 2025, Resco joined forces with RHI Magnesita, becoming part of the global refractory leader.

name: Revtech Manufacturing
old_description: RevTech Manufacturing was built on a strong foundation of innovation, experience, and precision. The brand grew from two companies founded by Leonard Koren: GK Engineering, a 3D printing company started in 1997, and International Mold and Production LLC, launched in 2003. This history reflects a long-standing commitment to advanced manufacturing and dependable production solutions.
about:
RevTech Manufacturing is based in Kenosha, Wisconsin. The business traces its roots to 1997 when Leonard Koren founded GK Engineering, a 3D printing company, and to 2003 when he launched International Mold and Production LLC. Those two entities were later combined under the RevTech Manufacturing brand, which today operates with Leonard Koren as president and family members holding key management roles.

The company provides a full spectrum of manufacturing services, including CAD design, in‑house CMM inspection, mold design, CNC and EDM mold fabrication, additive manufacturing (3D printing), plastic injection molding, stainless steel polishing, prototype and production tooling, and custom handle and grip solutions. RevTech also maintains an offshore mold‑building operation, IMAP, with capabilities in Asia and Europe, allowing it to support projects from early prototyping through long‑term production.

RevTech serves businesses across a broad geographic footprint — including the Chicago, Milwaukee, Atlanta, Dallas, and Scottsdale areas — that require custom plastic parts, tooling, and additive manufacturing. Typical customers are companies needing design assistance, prototype development, or full‑scale injection molded components for applications ranging from consumer products to industrial equipment.

The company emphasizes its decades of experience in both 3D printing and injection molding as a core differentiator. It promotes a full‑service model that spans design, validation, tooling, and production, backed by in‑house quality checks and a commitment to on‑time delivery. RevTech states its mission is to deliver high‑quality, defect‑free parts on schedule while providing expert guidance at every stage.
